name: cutscene
description: Make and edit videos with your AI agent: animated HTML compositions, footage edits cut by the words, local AI voices you design or clone, captions and music. Everything runs on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Make videos with your AI agent
interface.longDescription: Plan, build and preview videos with your AI agent. Cutscene writes animated HTML compositions with GSAP, speaks voiceovers with local AI voices you design or clone (with permission), checks every spoken word, adds captions, music and sound effects, and cleans up footage: silences, retakes, highlights and vertical reframes. One beat sheet keeps voice, footage and graphics in sync, and every video gets its own look. Everything runs on your computer.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-second intro for my channel with a logo reveal and a voiceover
Turn this script into a 30-second explainer with captions
